predicate.text: Inadequate sanitation ... to an extent that endangers the life, limb, health, property, safety, or welfare of the public or the occupants thereof

anchors.description: Full bathroom with working toilet, sink, and tub/shower; hot and cold running water at all fixtures; kitchen sink with hot water; all plumbing connected to the sewer lateral and draining freely; mechanical exhaust fans in bathroom and kitchen; no moisture damage.
All fixtures present and functional; bathroom exhaust fan is missing so the occupant cracks a window instead; minor caulk mildew around the tub; water heater delivers hot water but recovery is slow.

Working toilet and sink; the shower drains slowly and gurgles; hot water at the kitchen sink is intermittent because the unit shares an undersized water heater with the main house; a persistent damp smell in the bathroom; one visible patch of surface mold about the size of a hand on the ceiling.

Toilet functions but rocks on its base with staining at the floor joint suggesting a compromised wax seal; no dedicated bathroom sink (occupants use the kitchen sink); hot water only at the kitchen; recurring mold across roughly a quarter of the bathroom ceiling despite repeated cleaning; grey-water odor near the exterior cleanout.

Toilet backs up weekly and the occupant keeps a plunger and bucket in use; drain line appears improperly sloped where it crosses the crawlspace; no hot water in the unit at all; extensive mold in the bathroom and on the bedroom wall shared with it; visible sewage residue at an open cleanout near the entry.

No functioning toilet — occupants use the main house bathroom at night and a portable camping toilet otherwise; the abandoned toilet drains into a broken lateral with raw sewage pooling under the unit; no running water in what serves as the kitchen; pervasive sewage odor indoors; black mold covering large areas of two rooms.
